info.name: Gym Management System API
info.description: Koleksi uji UTS Framework Programming. JALANKAN LEWAT COLLECTION RUNNER secara berurutan (folder 1 sampai 8): request saling bergantung lewat collection variables. Pastikan server berjalan di {{baseUrl}}.

exec: pm.test("Body berisi id & email", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("memberEmail")); });
pm.test("message berisi daftar error validasi", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test("Status ACTIVE & endDate dihitung server", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("ACTIVE"); pm.expect(j.endDate).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.member).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(j.membershipPlan).to.be.an("object"); });
pm.test("Status EXPIRED, endDate 2020-01-30", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("EXPIRED"); pm.expect(j.endDate).to.eql("2020-01-30"); });
pm.test("Semua hasil ACTIVE milik member A", function () { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a).to.have.lengthOf(1); a.forEach(m => pm.expect(m.status).to.eql("ACTIVE")); });

exec: pm.test("3 membership, semua punya status & plan", function () { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a).to.have.lengthOf(3); a.forEach(m => { pm.expect(m.status).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(m.membershipPlan).to.be.an("object"); }); });

pm.test("2 peserta, kuota habis", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalParticipants).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.availableSlots).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.participants[0].member).to.be.an("object"); });
